Introduction

Lee Dong-hyuck, best known by his stage name Haechan, is a South Korean singer under SM Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group NCT and its sub-units NCT 127, NCT Dream, and NCT U. He made his official debut on July 7, 2016 with NCT 127's mini album "NCT #127".

Haechan is set to have his solo debut on September 8, 2025, with the release of his first full-length album, titled TASTE. The lead single will be "CRZY".
